remarks: Come see this adorable 3 bedroom freshly-painted rental with walking distance to Middle School, High School, the train and all of Noroton Heights new shops and amenities. Just renovated this year with new kitchen, bathrooms and 2nd floor stackable wash/dryer, you'll be scrambling to get a lease signed. Common areas include: front porch, back deck and flat back yard behind garage (garage is storage space for landlord). There are approximately 3 off-street parking spaces between garage and deck available for tenants.  **Tenant responsible for credit check and references, liability insurance, 2-month security deposit, all utilities, which include electricity, cable, internet, heat, garbage removal and the water bill is evenly split (water company to be paid within 5 days from receiving bill from Landlord). Also oil heat must be purchased from oil co that landlord designates, currently it's Mitchell Fuel.
